thread:
alex: Heads up — Customer X hit tenant quota and got a 500 from /v1/generate. They expected 429. Happened on dedicated route.
miya: can you drop the raw response + headers? :eyes:
alex: ```http
HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
Content-Type: application/json
X-Route-Id: rt-43
X-Fallback: true
X-Quota-Decision: exceeded

{
  "error": "upstream_failure"
}
```
jordan: That header set suggests the router did a late quota check (post-routing) and then the shard returned a 5xx which bubbled up. We currently only map quota -> 429 at the gateway entrance, so late checks fall through to 5xx.
nishant: Right — with multitenant/dedicated pools we sometimes defer quota enforcement to the route side for admission control. That creates a contract hole: client sees a 5xx but the root cause is a quota.
sam: Proposal: canonicalize client-visible status at the API gateway. If the final decision reason contains 'quota' (anywhere in the call path), gateway should translate to 429 and add structured headers: `X-Client-Status: quota_exceeded`, `X-Quota-Origin: route|entry`, and a small subcode header like `X-Quota-Subcode: tenant_limit`. Internal infra errors still get 5xx but must include `X-Client-Status: infra_error` so SDKs can reason.
miya: +1 for canonicalization. One caveat: streaming responses. If we discover quota mid-stream we can't retroactively change HTTP status. For streaming: emit a terminal JSON event `{"type":"terminal","code":429,"reason":"quota_exceeded"}` and close the stream. Need to doc that.
jordan: Telemetry: add tags on `client_visible_status` metric: `quota_origin` (values: route|entry|none), `route_id`, and `quota_subcode`. Right now dashboards only show status_code & route; we lose signal about quota-driven degradations.
alex: Console UX needs a small copy patch for route-level quota banner. Proposed text: "Requests limited by tenant quota on this route. You can request higher limits from the Quotas page or contact support." Add a tooltip linking to quota analytics and per-route historical peak.
nishant: Rollout plan: feature flag `client_code_normalization` on gateway. Canary at 10% traffic for 24h, monitor: 1) spike in 429s (expected), 2) any increase in 5xx rate, 3) SDK error classification mismatches. Add an alert if 5xx_infra_rate increases > 5% over baseline.
miya: Also update SDK guidance: treat 429 as client backoff (do NOT aggressive retry), treat 5xx as retryable with exponential backoff. Add sample code to detect `X-Client-Status` header.
sam: I'll own the gateway mapping PR. @jordan will update mapping rules, @nishant will add telemetry tags + update the dashboard, @miya will update SDK + streaming docs, @alex will update console copy + support blurb.
deploy-bot: deploy triggered: feat/quota-normalize -> gateway-canary (10%)
ajordan: PR up: draft linked in #pull-requests. Added tests for header rewrite and streaming terminal event.
alex: I'll draft a brief customer follow-up explaining why they saw 500 and that we're rolling a fix to ensure quota shows as 429 with clearer help links. :thumbsup:
sam: One more operational note — ensure logs include `client_visible_status` and `internal_cause` fields so debugging is faster (don't force people to grep multiple services).
miya: sounds good. I'll schedule a 30m sync if anything unexpected shows up during canary.
alex: thanks everyone — let's keep the console copy conservative. Follow-ups in PR comments.
